import num2words
import re
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split


def process_unknown_token(token):
    # Handle numeric tokens
    if re.match(r"^-?\d+([.,]\d+)?$", token):
        try:
            num_str = token.replace(",", ".").lstrip("0")
            num = float(num_str)
            if num.is_integer():
                return num2words(int(num), lang="ru")
            else:
                return num2words(num, lang="ru")
        except:
            return "<self>"
    # Handle basic punctuation
    elif token in {".", ",", "!", "?", "—", ";", ":", "..."}:
        return "sil"
    return "<self>"


# Load and prepare data
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/ru_train.csv", usecols=["before", "after"])
mapping = train_df.groupby("before")["after"].agg(lambda x: x.mode()[0]).to_dict()

    test_df["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + test_df["token_id"].astype(str)
)

# Generate predictions
test_df["after"] = test_df["before"].map(mapping)
missing_mask = test_df["after"].isna()
test_df.loc[missing_mask, "after"] = test_df.loc[missing_mask, "before"].apply(
